name: claudeconnect
notes: The empty page is just the greeting and the message box, centred in the window: the Write or edit, Search the web and Browse files rows under it are gone.

Files opens in place of the chat, so the sidebar stays and the Chat | Files switch doesn't move. Chat (or Esc) goes back, so the file browser has no close button. Picking a chat or New chat in the sidebar goes back too.
Effort is a slider in the model menu, from Faster to Smarter, with the model's default marked Recommended, instead of a list.
The send arrow has ChatGPT's weight, and icons take the colour of the text beside them, as ChatGPT's do.
